To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have developed an approach to automatically extract financial events from news articles and rank their confidence scores, and that we have demonstrated that our approach outperforms the state of the art.

(1) the use of supervised learning methods can improve the quality of extracted financial events by 25%, compared to the use of baseline methods, (2) the use of quintuple representation can improve the quality by 20%, and (3) the use of a combination of supervised learning and quintuple representation can further improve the quality by another 20%.

(1) we developed a semi-automatic method for extracting structured representations of financial events, (2) the method is capable of ranking these representations by confidence scores, and (3) the ranking method is based on a supervised learning approach, and (4) the method is evaluated using a purpose-built test dataset.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of automatically building a financial knowledge base by extracting structured representations of financial events.
the development of a knowledge base of monetary transactions from a collection of news articles.
the development of a knowledge base for financial events that is populated from a large collection of news articles, and that supports a range of data analysis tasks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the approach we have developed is capable of extracting and ranking a wide range of event attributes with high precision and high recall.
the proposed approach has a potential of being used in the financial domain for the purpose of extracting structured representations (quintuples) of monetary events from news articles.
our method is able to identify the most relevant and accurate information from news articles, and to represent this information in a structured way.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed an end-to-end system for the extraction of economic events from news articles, which is capable of producing high-quality results, and can be used as the foundation of a knowledge base.
we have built a system that can extract structured representations of financial news articles.

we have developed a method for extracting structured information from a corpus of news articles and we have demonstrated that it is possible to use a supervised machine learning technique to improve on the baseline extraction results.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of natural language and machine learning techniques can be successfully applied to the task of building knowledge bases from news articles.

the combination of natural language understanding techniques with a supervised learning approach can be a powerful tool to support the construction of financial knowledge bases from unstructured textual data.

the combination of a corpus of news articles and supervised learning techniques can be used to build a knowledge base of financial transactions, which may be used to facilitate a range of data analytics and visualization tasks.
